relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: we tested the effect of 3 months treatment with Galcanezumab-GCA, a monoclonal antibody directed to CGRP

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: At T2, the EEG power significantly diminished as compared to T0 and T1 at occipital sites, and the topographical analysis confirmed a restoration of SSVEPs within normal values.

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: At T2, there was a reduction of headache frequency and disability.

key_findings: Three months of galcanezumab normalized elevated occipital SSVEP power and oxyhemoglobin responses in drug-resistant migraine patients.
The central electrophysiological effect did not correlate with clinical improvement, and BBB passage of the antibody remains unresolved.
